info.name: Nuon Accounts API
info.description:
API for managing nuon apps, components, installs, and actions.

Contact Support:
 Name: Nuon Support
 Email: support@nuon.co

item.name: create a static API token for your org

request.description: Creates a long-lived static API token scoped to your current org. Each token gets its own dedicated service account, and only grants access to the current org.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

request.description: Deletes a static API token belonging to your current org, along with its dedicated service account. Once deleted, the token can no longer be used to access the API.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

item.name: list your org's static API tokens

request.description: Lists the static API tokens for your current org. Token secrets are never returned.
